item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,work\\nreq=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nexpected=[{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['S1','X1'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['D1'],'unknowns':[]}]\\ngot=[work.evaluate(r,ev,pol) for r in req]; assert got==expected,(got,expected)\\nassert json.load(open('report.json'))==expected\\nfor out in got:\\n assert set(out)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}\\nr={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}}; e=[{'source':'s','claim':'c','value':None,'conditions':{'a':1},'verified':True}]; p={'required_conditions':['a'],'require_verified':True}; before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); assert work.evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['s'],'unknowns':[]}; assert (r,e,p)==before\\nprint('current report and API checks passed')\"]}"}
